[Kenya National Public Health Institute (KNPHI)]{.org}

- Trained in Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR); took part in the Africa CDC, KNPHI and Ministry of Health workshop on toolkit assessment, surveillance system mapping and gap analysis.
- Investigated water-borne and hand-swelling disease outbreaks in Kakamega County schools by developing standardised case definitions and reviewing national reporting frameworks.
- Analysed epidemiological data from Kenya's Visceral Leishmaniasis outbreak, comparing mortality across clinical treatment regimens to guide public health interventions.
